items.title: Every finite constructible stratification of an affine scheme is refined by the stratification attached to a finite set of elements
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a finite stratification of the spectrum of a ring by constructible subsets there is a finite set of elements whose associated vanishing-pattern stratification refines it (statement lines 770-776). The proof (proof lines 778-787) writes the strata through quasi-compact opens and their complements, replaces the quasi-compact opens by finitely many basic opens, and reads off the refinement from the vanishing patterns. H2: a three-step explicit construction with three inputs, written out in full.
